preconditions.description: The input n must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' if n <= 0 else len(return_value.split('\n')) == 2 * n - 1
postconditions.description: The function returns an empty string if n is 0 or negative. Otherwise, it returns a string with exactly 2n-1 lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == len(return_value.split('\n')[n-1]) for line in return_value.split('\n')) if n > 0 else True
postconditions.description: All lines in the pattern have the same length, equal to the length of the longest line, if n is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, k+1)) + ''.join(str(i) for i in range(k-1, 0, -1)) in return_value.split('\n')[k-1] for k in range(1, n+1)) if n > 0 else True
postconditions.description: Each line k (1 <= k <= n) contains the sequence '12...k-1k(k-1)...21' centered in the line, if n is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, k+1)) + ''.join(str(i) for i in range(k-1, 0, -1)) in return_value.split('\n')[2*n-k-1] for k in range(1, n+1)) if n > 0 else True
postconditions.description: Each line 2n-k (1 <= k <= n) contains the sequence '12...k-1k(k-1)...21' centered in the line, if n is greater than 0.
